latest.name: Gazeora v1.0.1-rc.1
latest.body:
## What's Changed
* Fix security vulnerabilities in the native client by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora-Android/pull/4
* fix: rename layout shader uniform that adreno drivers reject by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora-Android/pull/5
* refactor: move shaders into their own files by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora-Android/pull/6
* feat: float gazeora's window in the room over the back camera by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora-Android/pull/7
* ci: add a weekly patch pre-release by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora-Android/pull/8
* feat: track the viewer's hands and point at gazeora's window by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora-Android/pull/9
* docs: offer the app under a commercial license as well as the gpl by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora-Android/pull/10
* feat: track the head with the phone's rotation sensor by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora-Android/pull/11
* feat: turn the camera off in the dark and report its status to the pc by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora-Android/pull/12
* feat: add a build option to leave out the camera status for the overlay by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora-Android/pull/13
* docs: rewrite the readme and add guides by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora-Android/pull/14
* build: run the head orientation host tests in ci by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora-Android/pull/15
* feat: add a report a problem button by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora-Android/pull/16
* feat: spin the logo's rings like a gyroscope by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora-Android/pull/17


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora-Android/compare/v1.0.0-rc.1...v1.0.1-rc.1
